faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NISER Special Work-based Consultant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Special Work-based Consultant position at NISER Bhubaneswar is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc degree in Life Sciences or allied branches from a recognized Institute or university to be eligible for the Special Work-based Consultant role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Special Work-based Consultant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contractual position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 10,000 per month for the Special Work-based Consultant position.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NISER Special Work-based Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted via email. You should prepare your bio-data, attach required documents, and send it to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Special Work-based Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will be based on an Online Interview conducted via Google Meet.

faq.question: Q8. When will the online interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The online interview for the Special Work-based Consultant position is scheduled to be held on 17th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. The recruitment is for a Special Work-based Consultant role on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all detailed information regarding the recruitment.
